advisor.reasoning: Current KSAT 20:51Z reads 21.1°C (70.0°F) with OVC deck at 1800/3100/4600ft and SE winds 10kt — a persistent marine-moist airmass advecting from SE Gulf. Run_max is only 71.6°F, barely above the 71°F cap. The diurnal curve peaked at hour 15 (71.1°F) and is now declining. Cloud lid (BKN018-OVC046) is suppressing insolation. The B72.5 bucket (72-73°F) trades YES at 55, confirming market sees most probability just above 72°F, not clearing 71 by a comfortable margin. NWS grid at 74°F is an outlier vs OM consensus (71.2–73.4°F). With current temp at 70°F and descending curve, exceeding 71°F ceiling requires sustained heating through thick overcast in the late afternoon — mechanism absent.
